# hodor_workspace (Data Source)

The workspace the provider manages: the one its `workspace_id` names, which the API key must belong to. It takes no argument. A workspace that is not the key's fails the read with an error naming it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The workspace the provider manages, the one its workspace_id names. It takes
# no argument.
data "hodor_workspace" "this" {}

output "workspace" {
  value = "${data.hodor_workspace.this.name} (${data.hodor_workspace.this.id})"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The workspace's id, `ws_...`: the provider's `workspace_id`.
- `name` (String) The workspace's name, as its admins set it in the Hodor app.
